note: DATE-SETMONTH-001, CLOSED at zero. This was a ratchet of 30 sites; every one is fixed and the gate is now hard, so an empty list is the point rather than an accident. Date.setMonth OVERFLOWS rather than clamping - 31 March minus one month is 3 March, not 28 February - which makes the bare `d.setMonth(d.getMonth() +/- n)` idiom wrong on about four days in twelve of every year and silently right the rest of the time. Use subtractMonths / addMonths / monthsBetween / termEndDate from supabase/functions/_shared/date-months.ts, re-exported for the Node and browser trees as @shared/date-months. Do not re-populate this list: a fix belongs in the code, and a list of known-bad sites is somewhere a new one hides. REOPENED AT 15 ON 2026-09-21 BECAUSE THE GUARD GOT BETTER, NOT BECAUSE THE CODE GOT WORSE (REPORTS-CHARTS-002): the rule matched .setMonth only, so the UTC twin .setUTCMonth sat uncaught - supabase/functions/reports/_date.ts widened every report window by up to three days on the last days of a long month - and the YEAR form was never in scope at all. The month half is still at zero and is still a hard property; these 15 are all .setFullYear(x.getFullYear() +/- n), which overflows only on 29 February, resolving to 1 March. One day every four years, so it is a worklist rather than an outage: each entry wants subtractUtcYears or an explicit clamp. Do not read the jump from 0 to 15 as a regression.
